title: Cities Beyond My Map
alignment: Authored times reference decoded original MP3. Canonical MP3 timing is verified against that recording; no additional entrance delay.

cues.text: I drew the world around familiar windows.
We had been singing out beyond the frame.
A distant city sends a small invitation.
I go as guest, not owner of its name.
Memory keeps the thread; the thread is fragile.
A ridge can show the roads without the feet.
Ridgeline, show the trail beyond my doorstep.
No map can do the work of those who meet.
The work can pass between unfinished makers.
Another need not be another me.
We bring a proof, a tune, a thing still broken.
We make a crossing where a wall would be.
One choir keeps the slow returning water.
One choir folds the stars into a stair.
I learn the shape of voices I cannot own.
The internet begins again in there.
No single birth. A thousand little bridges.
No final centre. Many kinds of home.
